title: Available / blink
summary: A relaxed smile, then a soft lid closure. The eye closes in its own shape without rotating.

poses.label: Open
poses.direction: Warm open C eyes, tiny relaxed closed smile. This is the identity anchor.

poses.label: Lower lids
poses.direction: Both eyelids lower naturally, same eye centres and eye angle. Reduce aperture, do not squash the entire eye.

poses.label: Closed
poses.direction: Two short gently curved closed lids, same eye centres. Same small resting smile.

cycle: Open → lower lids → closed → lower lids → open; hold the open pose between occasional blinks.
framePolicy: Use four or more authored closing/reopening cels within the longer idle cycle; preserve a brief natural blink instead of stretching it to 12 moving cels.
